findings.title: Sibling-move re-homes slug init to CustomerMapShell, but TrackingPage early-returns BEFORE the shell mounts — public link 404s on the first render
findings.detail: Today t/:code is a CHILD of CustomerLayout, whose useState(ensureFleetSlug) runs during render before useTrackingPublic's fetch effect fires — this is why the logged-out public link does not 404 on localhost (CLAUDE.md -> 'F-05 fleet-slug resolution + synchronous persist'; getPublicTrack attaches X-Fleet-Slug from authStorage). WI-4 removes CustomerLayout from tracking's tree and attributes slug/silent-refresh re-run to CustomerMapShell (CustomerMapShell.tsx:152-166). But the current TrackingPage returns <Centered> for loading/expired/none BEFORE rendering any map surface (TrackingPage.tsx:208,219,247). On a direct public-link load, isLoading && !hasData hits the loading early-return -> CustomerMapShell never mounts -> ensureFleetSlug never runs -> public/track fires with no X-Fleet-Slug -> 404 on localhost. MapOrderPage escapes this because it has no pre-shell early-returns; TrackingPage does. The e2e page.goto('/customer/t/...?k=...') (customer.spec.ts:171-178) with no prior page will catch this at the gate -> rework if built 'mirroring MapOrderPage'. WI-4's existing public-link note only covers the 401/silent-refresh angle, not this 404/slug angle.
findings.suggested_fix: WI-4 must hoist ensureFleetSlug into TrackingPage's own useState initializer — exactly the CustomerLoginPage precedent (CustomerLoginPage.tsx:45 'useState(ensureFleetSlug)', a sibling for the same F-05 reason) — OR always mount CustomerMapShell and move the loading/expired/none meta-states into bottomSlot so the shell's initializer always runs. Cite CLAUDE.md -> 'F-05 fleet-slug resolution'.

findings.title: expired/none/loading meta-state composition unspecified; 'Odkaz vyprsel' must stay a heading-role element
findings.detail: WI-2's TrackingSheet owns only the 6 order-status phases (searching/assigned/arrived/inProgress/completed/cancelled). The meta-states (public 410 -> 'Odkaz vyprsel', 'none' -> login prompt, loading) are NOT order-status phases and are not covered by WI-2. WI-4 mentions them in Error Paths but does not specify their DOM. e2e customer.spec.ts:178 asserts getByRole('heading', { name: 'Odkaz vyprsel' }); the current TrackingPage renders it as a styled.h2 (ExpiredTitle, TrackingPage.tsx:36-41,211). If the rewrite drops that h2, AC#3's e2e REDs. Same root cause as F1 (early-return composition).
findings.suggested_fix: WI-4: specify that expired/none/loading render inside the shell (or standalone) with 'Odkaz vyprsel' kept as a heading-role element (h2 semantics preserved), and add a component test asserting getByRole('heading', { name: 'Odkaz vyprsel' }) so the e2e cannot RED.

findings.title: customer.tracking.reorder already exists — reuse, do not re-declare
findings.detail: WI-1's AC#3 lists 'customer.tracking.reorder' as a likely NEW delta to add to all six locales. It already exists in cs-CZ.json:1051 ('Objednat znovu'). Re-declaring an existing key risks a merge conflict / parity churn; the WI's own assumption block correctly says 'do NOT re-declare keys that already exist' — the AC's example list contradicts it.
findings.suggested_fix: WI-1: verify each proposed i18n delta against cs-CZ.json first; reuse customer.tracking.reorder as-is. Only genuinely new keys (e.g. a sheet aria-label, any new ride-summary label) get added to all six locales.

findings.title: RatingForm.tsx doc comment references StatusHeadline (removed in WI-4) — stale reference
findings.detail: RatingForm.tsx:75 comment reads 'Rating control dropped into the StatusHeadline ratingSlot'. StatusHeadline is removed in WI-4; RatingForm only references it in a comment (not an import), so removal is tsc-safe, but the comment becomes stale/misleading (rating now lands in TrackingSheet's ratingSlot).
findings.suggested_fix: WI-4: update the RatingForm.tsx:75 comment to name TrackingSheet's ratingSlot instead of StatusHeadline.

verified_not_findings: Router sibling-move is CORRECT: CustomerMapShell self-runs ensureFleetSlug + enableSilentRefresh (CustomerMapShell.tsx:152-166), so nesting TrackingPage-with-shell under CustomerLayout would double-invoke them; mirrors MapOrderPage; WI-4 removes the old nested t/:code child, killing the ambiguous double-match.

Leaflet-lazy discipline holds: WI-3 threads carMarker/pickupMarker as plain LatLng data props (mirroring cameraTarget); Marker/divIcon built inside CustomerMapBackground (sole MapyMap/leaflet importer); no WI passes a Marker/ReactNode map prop; page never imports react-leaflet. AC#7 + size budget safe.

Reuse-vs-rebuild holds: WI-1 EXTENDS headlineRules; WI-2 reuses CancelDialog/RatingForm/StarPicker/useCancelOrder/useRateOrder through props (no duplicated mutation); WI-3/WI-4 reuse selectCarMarker/trackingMarker/trackingMode/useTrackingAuthed/useTrackingPublic/usePositionStore/useFleetHub unchanged.

Pure-module discipline holds: markerInterpolation (WI-1) imports nothing from leaflet/react/DOM, fake-timer testable, reduced-motion via a pure decision; the rAF per-frame tick lives in the lazy map component (WI-3) in LOCAL state, not threaded through the shell.
e2e contracts survive: headline.new/assignedNoEta/cancelled/completed/expired all pinned; WI-2 asserts headings via getByRole('heading'); WI-3 keeps '.tracking-car-icon' verbatim.
WI-1 correctly UPDATES the existing headlineRules.test.ts Assigned->assignedNoEta assertion to the new Assigned->headline.new behavior; files_touched + test_cases both cover it.
Removal without dangling: StatusHeadline/TrackingMap/TrackingMapInner consumed only within tracking/; WI-4's remove-after-rewrite order is sound.
Topo sound: WI-1 -> WI-2 || WI-3 -> WI-4; no cycles.
AC coverage: all 7 acceptance criteria map to WIs.
Public 410 stops polling; public/track AllowAnonymous (410/404 never 401) so silent-refresh-on-401 never redirects a logged-out viewer — WI-4 pins with a public-mode test.
